name: php-regex/regex-parser
description: The PCRE2 regex parser: lexer, immutable AST, validator that answers as PHP's PCRE2 would for a chosen release, AST cache and the small AST analyses.

suggest.psr/cache: To share the AST cache through a PSR-6 pool.
suggest.psr/simple-cache: To share the AST cache through a PSR-16 cache.
suggest.ext-intl: To resolve \N{name} escapes by Unicode name.
